title: E-Commerce Website for a Retail Trader
description: A fully functional e-commerce platform designed for a retail trader of spices. Features include product listing, shopping cart, secure payment gateway, and a comprehensive admin dashboard for managing inventory, orders, and users.

title: Car Wash Booking Website
description: An intuitive car wash booking platform built with TypeScript and Tailwind. It features a secure payment gateway, user-friendly booking system, and an admin dashboard for managing services, bookings, and customer details.

title: Task Management App
description: A productivity app for managing tasks and projects, allowing users to create, assign, and track progress. It includes real-time updates, user authentication, and a dashboard for seamless collaboration.

title: Portfolio Website
description: A professional portfolio website to showcase skills, projects, and contact details. It includes responsive design, optimized performance, and a clean user interface to make a strong first impression.

title: Blogging Platform
description: A dynamic platform for creating and publishing blog posts. Features include rich text editing, user authentication, commenting system, and user profiles, offering a complete blogging experience.

title: Real Estate Landing Page
description: A high-conversion landing page for real estate businesses. Includes property listings, contact forms, and an optimized layout for mobile and desktop.

title: Jewellery Store Landing Page
description: An elegant landing page designed for luxury jewellery businesses. Features a product showcase, customer testimonials, and secure payment options for seamless shopping.

title: Spa & Wellness Landing Page
description: A soothing and visually appealing landing page for spa and wellness centers. Designed to highlight services, customer reviews, and a booking form for easy appointment scheduling.

title: Restaurant & Café Landing Page
description: A visually stunning landing page for restaurants and cafés, showcasing the menu, chef's specials, and an easy-to-use reservation system.

title: Automotive Services Landing Page
description: A sleek and modern landing page for automotive services, featuring service details, customer testimonials, and a contact form for appointment scheduling.

title: Wholesale Trader/Exporter Landing Page
description: A specialized landing page for a wholesale trader/exporter dealing in rice, wheat, and similar commodities. It highlights products, certifications, and a simple contact form for inquiries.
